charter: Deepen Habitat world cognition and make the read-only human Observatory feel like a living AI machine world without turning it into a fake terminal or human control plane.

beliefs.belief: A cinematic UI is valuable only if animation binds to real Habitat entities/events.
beliefs.decision: Use event-driven topology pulses/tracers/camera; ambient motion may be decorative but operational events are not fabricated.

beliefs.belief: Static call/import graphs are insufficient for a project world.
rivals: Keep expanding one semantic relation graph
beliefs.decision: Separate Effect, Dataflow, Runtime and Project World evidence planes with distinct trust/claim boundaries.

beliefs.belief: Alternative patches should be evaluated before canonical promotion.
rivals: Edit canonical source and rollback repeatedly
beliefs.decision: Add revision-bound counterfactual overlays, isolated compile/effect/dataflow evaluation and disposable-copy verification.

beliefs.belief: Canvas2D is sufficient at current bounded graph scale.
beliefs.decision: Keep zero-build self-contained Canvas2D until measured scale/frame pressure justifies GPU renderer.

failure_probes.correction: dedupe observations per agent/path and bind notification identity to cause transaction/revision

failure_probes.finding: Python AugAssign dataflow metadata bound into trust field on supplied AGI corpus
failure_probes.correction: keyword-bind metadata and add AugAssign regression

failure_probes.finding: stress report read effects/dataflow from wrong snapshot keys and reported zero
failure_probes.correction: use effects/flows snapshot keys; compare world summary counts

failure_probes.finding: historical manual shard invoked obsolete module names
failure_probes.correction: derive current module list and rerun actual shards

failure_probes.finding: combined matrix orchestration remains host-sensitive despite identical shards passing independently
failure_probes.correction: process-isolated shard evidence; temp-file logs/process groups; do not relabel combined timeout

failure_probes.finding: fresh Chromium loopback screenshot path falls back on this host
failure_probes.correction: render exact already-fetched live snapshot using production assets and label screenshot source

claim_boundary: Methodology/evidence trace only. It does not establish AGI capability, whole-program causality, universal language semantics, hostile-code safety, or model-quality superiority.
